rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2-2.5 and Tables 1-5 report a two-year rain-fed field experiment (randomized block, three replicates) measuring soil respiration, Q10, soil temperature/moisture, yield and biomass under wheat and maize with and without N fertilization.
rows.notes: The study is a rain-fed field experiment on the Loess Plateau on how crop type and nitrogen fertilization affect soil respiration and its temperature sensitivity (Q10). It contains no drip irrigation, no irrigation system at all, no emitter spacing, irrigation scheduling, fertigation uniformity, or any assessment of management precision constraining crop productivity. Yield differences reported are between fertilized and unfertilized plots under rainfed conditions, not drip system management. The study provides no evidence on the claim.

notes: Full text appears complete. The cited study concerns soil respiration/Q10 under crop types and N fertilization in rain-fed agriculture; it is unrelated to drip irrigation management precision, so the citation appears misattributed.
